name: continuous climbing
description: Easy climbing or traversing without stopping for 10 to 20 minutes or more. It builds aerobic endurance in the forearms and gives you plenty of relaxed movement practice.
instructions: Choose terrain well below your limit, such as a long traverse or easy routes.
Start climbing and keep moving without stepping off the wall.
Keep the effort low enough that you could talk while you climb, with only a light pump.
Shake out on good holds and breathe steadily.
Continue for 10 to 20 minutes or longer.
Ease off or move to bigger holds if the pump starts to build.
